correctness.rationale: The precise graph and synchronous monotone process are defined and quantified for all 0<p<1. A complete integer census across 15 unordered seed pairs and 16 independent threshold vectors per pair is proved using automorphism classes and the displayed H/J table; the independent stable-closure characterization reproduces all entries. Polynomial expansions and strict algebraic factorizations establish both global optimizer regimes and all tie cases; the packaged checker completed 348 exact assertions. Finite enumeration is exhaustive because the entire domain has 240 configurations.

value.rationale: Two triangles bridged by one edge are a canonical motif for two cohesive social communities, and selecting precisely two initial advocates is a natural control intervention. The exact p crossover and strict disagreement between average reach and total-community adoption distinguish two operationally important objective functions. This is a motivated finite complete classification useful as a benchmark; no extrapolation to general graphs or real empirical intervention is asserted.
